title: Continuity Pack
user: Small businesses using self-hosted or local admin software who need a tested, readable recovery pack for invoices, customers, and business records.
smallest_useful_product: Local CLI that packages configured export files, hashes and encrypts them, writes a plain-language restore manifest, verifies a target copy, and runs a scheduled dry-read. Non-goals: hosted backup storage, database administration, or vendor-specific restore automation.
success_measure: A pilot owner can locate and verify a complete recent recovery pack in under ten minutes, and scheduled verification fails loudly within one run when the target is unavailable.
constraints: Use authenticated encryption and OS keychain/passphrase support; never upload without an explicit target; document that verification is not a full application restore.
